# Form Items: Upsert a Collection of Form Items

Area overview and notes: [form-items.md](../form-items.md)

`POST /form-items/batch` · tenant-scoped token

Inserts or Updates the form items with the provided ids. If they do not exist, they are created.

**Request body** (required, JSON)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `form_items` | array of object | No | An array of form items to be upserted. A maximum of 100 form items. |
| `form_items[].id` | string (unique id) | Yes | Your system's unique identifier for the form item. |
| `form_items[].user_id` | string (unique id) | Yes | Your system's unique identifier for the Account (User) |

Example request body:

```json
{"form_items":[{"id":"12345abcde","user_id":"abcde12345","document_type":"1099_B","tax_year":2023,"cusip_number":"38259P508","asset_name":"Bitcoin","asset_symbol":"BTC","asset_quantity":"123","acquired_date":"04/22/2021","disposed_date":"04/22/2021","proceeds":"123.12","cost_basis":"123.12","accrued_market_discount":"123.12","wash_sale":"123.12","gain_loss_classification":"Ordinary","collectibles_qof_classification":"Collectibles","federal_tax_withheld":"123.12","is_noncovered_security":true,"proceeds_type":"Gross Proceeds","is_loss_not_allowed_based_on_proceeds":true,"bartering":"123.12","state_code":"CA","state_id":"123456789","state_tax_withheld":"123.12"},{"id":"67890fghij","user_id":"abcde12345","document_type":"1099_INT","tax_year":2023,"interest_income":"100.00","early_withdrawal_penalty":"100.00","interest_on_us_savings_bonds_and_treasury_obligations":"100.00","federal_tax_withheld":"100.00","investment_expense":"100.00","foreign_tax_paid":"100.00","foreign_country_or_us_possession":"LU","tax_exempt_interest":"100.00","specified_private_activity_bond_interest":"100.00","market_discount":"100.00","bond_premium":"100.00","bond_premium_on_treasury_obligations":"100.00","bond_premium_on_tax_exempt_bond":"100.00","tax_exempt_and_tax_credit_bond_cusip":"38259P508","state":"CA","payers_state_number":"123456789","state_tax_withheld":"100.00"}]}
```

**Response 200**: Batch form item upsert response.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `successes` | array of object | No | Form items that were successfully created or updated. |
| `successes[].form_item` | one of several shapes | No |  |
| `successes[].form_item.id` | string (unique id) | Yes | Your system's unique identifier for the form item. |
| `successes[].form_item.user_id` | string (unique id) | Yes | Your system's unique identifier for the Account (User) |
| `failures` | array of object | No | Form item objects that failed to be created or updated. |
| `failures[].form_item` | one of several shapes | No |  |
| `failures[].form_item.id` | string (unique id) | Yes | Your system's unique identifier for the form item. |
| `failures[].form_item.user_id` | string (unique id) | Yes | Your system's unique identifier for the Account (User) |
| `failures[].error` | string | No | If a form item failed to upload, this property contains the reason. |

**Errors:** 400 Bad Request · 429 Too Many Requests
